newsitem.title: GERMANY: German ad and media firms expand in multimedia-MGM.
newsitem.headline: German ad and media firms expand in multimedia-MGM.

text.p: Most German advertising and media companies say they plan to boost investments and hiring in their multimedia divisions this year, media marketing company MediaGruppe Muenchen (MGM) said on Thursday.

MGM said in a summary of a poll it had conducted among industry executives with market research firm GfK and ad industry magazine Horizont that more than 80 percent of respondents said they planned to "significantly increase" their investments in multimedia in 1997.
MGM said the survey showed most of the investment would go towards the Internet, CD-ROM and commercial online services.
Nearly 70 percent planned hirings this year for multimedia-related work, it added.

The executives said they were also focusing their investments particularly on Intranet systems -- online communication within companies and Business-TV, company information services available over televisions.
MGM released the poll summary at the two-day Munich Advertising Conference, a congress of representatives from the German media and advertising industries.
